comment: Thresholds for test/lighthouse/budgets.spec.mjs. Edit here, not in the spec.
Set from 15 measurements: three full runs of the spec across the five pages below.
Observed performance 92 to 99, FCP 1205 to 2256ms, LCP 1953 to 3081ms, TBT 0 to 2ms,
Ceilings sit roughly a third above the observed maximum. That absorbs the container
load that moves FCP by a full second between runs while still catching a real
regression, such as a render-blocking script or an image without dimensions.
Re-measure with three runs before tightening any of these; every run prints its
numbers on a line starting with LH.
cumulative-layout-shift is unitless. Every other metric is milliseconds.
